item.fnc.black_cat_bracelet.description: Unarmed hits trigger a Bad Wild Magic effect on the target.
item.fnc.blood_lust_bracelet.description: If the wearer uses smites, they gain a small regeneration effect.
item.fnc.brimstone_sword.description: When a Smite is used with this sword, you regain 50% of the Smite damage as HP.
item.fnc.deck_of_many.description: Drawing a card from this deck applies an Extreme Wild Magic effect - good or bad is up to fate.
item.fnc.blessed_bow.description: This Bow can strike Smites from a distance.
item.fnc.four_leaf_clover_ring: Ring of the Four Leaf Clover
item.fnc.four_leaf_clover_ring.descripti: Protects the user from catastrophic Wild Magic Effects
item.fnc.time_belt.description: Doubles the duration of each beneficial Potion effect
item.fnc.aura_fraud_ring.description: This ring allows to ignore the mana costs of auras.
item.fnc.heavy_weapon_ring.description: Weapon damage is increased by 25%, as long as you aren't wielding anything in your off-hand.
item.fnc.heavy_weapon_ring_greater.descr: Weapon damage is increased by 50%, as long as you aren't wielding anything in your off-hand.
item.fnc.frenzy_ring.description: For each kill within 30 seconds, you gain 1 Stack of Frenzy, for up to 5 stacks. Each Stack provides an 15% damage boost.
item.fnc.frenzy_ring_greater.description: For each kill within one minute, you gain 1 Stack of Frenzy, for up to 10 stacks. Each Stack provides an 15% damage boost.
item.fnc.second_protection_ring.descript: There is a 20% chance that you don't suffer any Damage of an incoming attack
item.fnc.second_attack_ring.description: There is a 20% chance that an attack of yours connects a second time. On a success, this loops with another 20% Chance.
item.fnc.second_drop_ring.description: There is a 20% chance that an beneficial Potion Effect is amplified by one. On a success, this loops with another 20% Chance.
item.fnc.glittering_potato.description: A mysterious potato blessed with unstable magic. It may heal for 4 HP or explode. Choose wisely.
item.fnc.ring_of_wild_luck.description: You gain one level of luck and this allows players from other factions to trigger Wild Magic as well
item.fnc.wild_pickaxe.description: A pickaxe, that drops a random ore, when it mines one
item.fnc.sacrificial_dagger.description: A sharp dagger used for blood sacrifices. Right-click to sacrifice your own health for mana.
enchantment.fnc.holy_smite.desc: Smite damage dealt with this weapon counts as magic damage and pierces armor.
fnc:divine_armor_set_bonus:
(4) Set Bonus:
-50% Magic Damage
+50% Smite Duration
fnc:mischief_armor_set_bonus:
(4) Set Bonus:
+2 Wild Magic Luck
50% chance for a positive random SpellAdjustment
effect.fnc.bad_wild_magic.description: Your spells can trigger Wild Magic, and each level lowers your Wild Magic Luck by 1: Wild Magic is rolled once more per level and the worst result is kept.
effect.fnc.gamblers_blow_defensive.descr: Damage you take is randomly increased or decreased. Higher levels widen the range, and your Wild Magic Luck tips the roll.
effect.fnc.gamblers_blow_offensive.descr: Damage you deal is randomly increased or decreased. Higher levels widen the range, and your Wild Magic Luck tips the roll.
effect.fnc.booming_smite.description: Your melee hits deal extra Smite damage and cause an explosion at the target.
effect.fnc.burning_smite.description: Your melee hits deal extra Smite damage and set the target on fire.
effect.fnc.crippling_smite.description: Your melee hits deal extra Smite damage and inflict Weakness and Slowness on the target.
effect.fnc.dispelling_smite.description: Your melee hits deal extra Smite damage and remove short, weak beneficial effects from the target.
effect.fnc.empowered.description: Raises every attribute of your spell components by one step per level (except Delay; Precision only up to its maximum).
effect.fnc.explosion_resistance.descript: Makes you immune to explosion damage.
effect.fnc.good_wild_magic.description: Your spells can trigger Wild Magic, and each level raises your Wild Magic Luck by 1: Wild Magic is rolled once more per level and the best result is kept.
effect.fnc.hexing_smite.description: Your melee hits deal extra Smite damage and hex the target, which prevents healing and increases the damage it takes.
effect.fnc.hex.description: Prevents all healing and increases the damage you take by 25% per level.
effect.fnc.living_bomb.description: You explode every 10 seconds. Higher levels cause bigger explosions. By default, the explosions do not break blocks.
effect.fnc.maximized.description: Sets every attribute of your spell components (except Delay) to its maximum. Minimized Magic of the same level cancels it out.
effect.fnc.minimized.description: Sets every attribute of your spell components (except Delay) to its minimum. Maximized Magic of the same level cancels it out.
effect.fnc.random_ore_miner.description: Every ore you mine drops a random ore instead.
effect.fnc.random_spell_adjustment.descr: Your next spell is changed by a random Spell Adjustment, for better or worse. Afterwards, Wild Magic goes on cooldown.
effect.fnc.silencing_smite.description: Your melee hits deal extra Smite damage and silence the target, so it cannot cast spells.
effect.fnc.wild_magic.description: Your spells have a high chance to trigger Wild Magic, even if you are not aligned with the Wild Courts.
effect.fnc.wild_magic_cooldown.descripti: Wild Magic cannot occur while this effect is active. Cannot be cured with milk.
effect.fnc.paladin_smite.description: Your melee hits deal extra Smite damage and cast your Paladin Smite spell on the target.
effect.fnc.counter_attack.description: When a creature damages you, your Counter Attack spell is cast on it. Each counter uses up one level.
effect.fnc.frenzy.description: Increases all damage you deal by 15% per level.
effect.fnc.final_dual.description: Binds you to the caster in a deadly duel: both of you take damage every second until one of you dies or the effect ends. Cannot be cured with milk.
effect.fnc.sacrificial_lamb.description: Damage you take is turned into mana for the blood mage who marked you.
effect.fnc.postponement.description: Incoming damage is stored instead of taken. When the effect ends, all of it hits you at once, bypassing armor and enchantments, and you suffer Chrono Exhaustion.

ritual.fnc.twisted_fealty.wrong_faction: Only Paladins with mistrust in their devotion are able to complete this ritual.
event.fnc.faction_ally_paladin: Your loyalty gives you the strength to ensure justice.  You have allied yourself with the Paladins!
event.fnc.faction_ally_wild: You feel the unpredictability of the magic around you, uniting with you.  You have allied yourself with the Wilde Courts!
event.fnc.faction_ally_blood_mage: Your blood boils with power. You have allied yourself with the Blood Mages!
